data.text: Three ranking ideas were measured this round: document title carried into each section (+0.04), query expansion by relevance feedback (-0.04, removed), a separate heading index (0, removed). The one that paid was a parameter nobody would write a plan about - BM25 length normalization, 0.75 to 0.45, worth +0.04 - because these units run from a forty-character note to a two-kilobyte section and the default assumes one kind of document. Plans about ranking are worth less than a golden set.
